edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: Save Prismatic Barrier for his Void Rift double-burst, not a stray Q poke — the shield eats a full W combo and gives the trade back to you.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Standing shoulder-to-shoulder with your ADC lets one Tectonic Disruption knock-up net both of you into the true-damage rotation — split up before he steps up.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Prismatic Barrier banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption (E): 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cd — the knockup starts the true-damage rotation; dodge it and the research stalls that long. - Keep your W (10-12s cd) banked for his best play. - His R (100/90/80s cd) is interruptible by any CC — punish the channel.

edits.before: Vel'Koz wins by landing Tectonic Disruption, denying your pattern, and owning the chip ledger and the tempo it buys.
edits.after: Vel'Koz wins by landing Tectonic Disruption (E, 10-12s cd) to knock you up, stacking Organic Deconstruction to true damage, and finishing the rotation before your Q root ever gets a window.

edits.before: You decide the fights your team attends — start them, peel them, or poke them out of existence.
edits.after: His Organic Deconstruction (P) and R deal true damage — armour and MR don't blunt it, so out-scale him on burst and root chain instead of building resistances to survive his poke.
